column1: # tools/mkgame.py builds ONLY what is listed here. Anything else in Tuxemon (a
# tileset, a creature's sprite, a character sheet) is left out of game.bin.
# A map cell drawn from an unlisted tileset loses that layer's tile, and the
# build reports how many cells lost one.
# Columns: kind, slug, licence, authors, source, status
#   slug     the tileset's name in Tiled, the creature's slug, or the sheet's
#   status   credited:   the licence and authors are taken from Tuxemon's
#            unverified: no entry found yet; used in G0 spikes only (G3's
#            confirmed:  checked by hand against the source link (G3)
#            ours:       drawn for this project, CC0, at tools/game_art/<slug>.png
# Left out on purpose (section 10): anything under the "XYG Open Source
# License" (Kelvin Shadewing's sets, and core_buildings, core_set pieces,
# core_indoor_walls and core_indoor_floors, which ATTRIBUTIONS.md says are
# built partly from them); LimeZu's purchased sets; anything non-commercial.

column1: # The townspeople are Tuxemon's sheets (mods/tuxemon/sprites/<slug>.png), each
# credited under "Character Front Sprites" in ATTRIBUTIONS.md, which names who
# drew its overland (walking) sprite. Checked at the source on 2026-10-16:
#   pboop's "16x16 Person Sprite" on OpenGameArt is CC0;
#   the Superpowers Asset Packs (Pixel-boy, Sparklin Labs) are CC0 (LICENSE.txt);
#   Catch Challenger's datapack (Jordan and Herman Brule): Tuxemon credits it
#   as CC BY, but github.com/alphaonex86/CatchChallenger-datapack states no
#   licence of its own. The owner chose to use these on Tuxemon's word
#   (2026-10-16); they're marked so in the licence column and in the credits.
# Left out: Granny (overland by Pixel Scuba, no licence found), and every
# sheet whose credit runs back to a non-commercial or XYG source.
# Tuxemon's `adventurer` sheet isn't used: it has no credit line, and its
# history (red_front, before 2022) runs back through sheets the credits list as
# non-commercial or XYG-licensed. The owner chose clean licences only (Q6).
